BrandForge — Vetted specialists in design, development, and marketing.

What we do:
- Connect clients with pre-vetted specialists across design, development, and marketing disciplines
- Match projects with the right expert based on outcome, budget, and timeline
- Hold payment in escrow and release only upon client approval of delivered work

Services offered:
- Design: Brand identity, UI/UX, motion & video content
- Development: Websites, apps, integrations, AI features
- Marketing: AI-assisted content, SEO, social growth, campaigns

How payment works:
- Funds held in escrow by BrandForge
- Released only after client approves the delivered work
- Protects clients from upfront payment risk
